objId.description: Id of obj that we evaluating metric on.

startTimestamp.description: Start timestamp to begin checking timeseries for {@link EventWindow}s.

endTimestamp.description: End timestamp for period of checking timeseries for the existence of {@link EventWindow}s

startAndEndExpression.description:
Expression to detect start and end of {@link EventWindow}.
Expression should return 1 for start and -1 for end.
A simple example: "rollingDiff(PowerConsumptionEWTest > 0.35 && PowerConsumptionEWTest < 0.45)".

title: This spec describes how to create {@link EventWindow} from {@link Timeseries}.
name: TimeseriesToEventWindowsSpec
